watch.summary: The streamer plays Arc Raiders for the first time and experiences instant shock upon realizing he lost his entire inventory after dying.

beats.what: Streamer checks his loadout after getting knocked out and asks what he lost.
Streamer sees all empty slots and asks in disbelief if he lost everything.
He exclaims 'Jesus' as the post-round screen appears, realizing the harsh penalty.
He repeats 'I lost everything' in total disbelief.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The comedic appeal relies on the relatable shock of a beginner discovering harsh extraction shooter mechanics for the first time. His escalating disbelief carries the short clip well.
